missionPremise: RULING 1, operator-approved 2026-08-19 in _inbox/2026-08-19_template_city_lens_build_sheet.md: 'not built' moves down one level, from describing the SURFACE to describing SOURCES. The finding it rests on is that the G-18 register's `Not built` disposition column was read as a destination rather than as a starting state, and across three agent handoffs 'this surface does not exist yet' hardened into 'this surface is meant to be empty'. The product could not distinguish 'we did not build Parks' from 'your city has no Parks data', and those are different sentences to a customer. This lane is the SEAM that makes the distinction expressible plus three exemplar domains that prove it works on shapes that differ; it is explicitly NOT all nineteen lenses, because over-building here would serialise what wave 2 should fan.
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this without me by running four things. (1) `node --test src/*.test.mjs` in the clone returns 237/237. (2) `GET /api/city-domains?cityKey=template-city` returns four regions in three distinct states, with `patrol-vehicles` reading `ungranted` and a basis that says the region is built and has no source, containing no 'not built' string. (3) `GET /api/city-domains?cityKey=empty-city` returns all four regions `no-fixture-source` with a basis, and zero records. (4) Composing the whole registry twice in two separate node processes produces byte-identical output. All four are recorded below with their raw results. Anything a wave-2 lane needs is then present: a domain descriptor to copy, a registry line to add, and guards it cannot skip.
scopeBasis: Boundaries and why they are these and not others. IN: the seam, the registry, three exemplar domains chosen because they differ in shape (compound, flat-with-a-dimension, built-but-ungranted), the adapter catalog, the pack's demonstration axis with its Neon column, two read routes, and the re-scope of every gate ruling 1 forces. OUT and deliberately so: the other fifteen lenses on the build sheet, because wave 2 fans one lane per lens and building them here would serialise that fan; anything under `web/`, because a sibling lane owns it on this card and a collision there costs both lanes; any lens RENDERING of the four-state model, for the same reason; connecting any feed or granting any adapter, which the dispatch places out of scope and the standing decisions forbid; deploying and merging, which are planner-owned. NOT out of scope but NOT DONE, stated so it is not mistaken for an exclusion: the four states reach no pixel yet.

determinismProof.note: TWO SEPARATE NODE PROCESSES, not two calls in one, so a module-level memo cannot fake the result. A second arm scans src/fixture-seam.mjs and every file under src/domains/ for Math.random, Date.now, new Date and toISOString, because the runtime arm catches a clock only if the two runs straddle a tick.

whatRemainsOpen: THE FOUR STATES REACH NO PIXEL. web/ belongs to the sibling lane on this card, so the shell still renders the pipeline's two-value ok/empty. The seam carries sourceStatus beside the shipped status so a wave-2 lane can read the fourth state without a contract change, but until a lens reads it the customer-visible sentence is unchanged. Code-done is not customer-done.
Fifteen of the eighteen lens regions on the build sheet have no domain. That is the deliberate exclusion, not an oversight: wave 2 fans one lane per lens onto this seam.

The three new adapter kinds carry no declared record shape except spireon. goto and powerbi state their basis for being undeclared, so a wave-2 Public works lane declares them when it builds that lens.
